name: UBS Global Investment Returns Yearbook (Dimson-Marsh-Staunton)
description: The annual long-run global asset-returns study by Elroy Dimson, Paul Marsh and Mike Staunton (London Business School / Cambridge), published by UBS: equity, bond, bill, inflation, currency and gold returns back to 1900 across 35 markets and five world composite indices, now in its 26th (2026) edition. UBS publishes a free public 'Public summary edition' PDF (extracted charts and key findings from the full 310-page report); the full report and underlying DMS dataset are commercial (contact the authors / a UBS representative). Useful here as the reference standard for long-run, cross-asset, cross-country annualized-return presentation, not as a data feed.

notes: The 2026 public summary edition (19 pages) downloads directly with no registration. It is extracts only: 'This report contains extracts from the full 310-page UBS Global Investment Returns Yearbook 2026 ... The table and chart numbers in the Summary Edition are not therefore consecutive but reflect the numbering in the full report.'

The full 310-page Yearbook is distributed to UBS clients by UBS; non-clients who want to purchase it are directed to contact Paul Marsh at London Business School (pmarsh@london.edu). The underlying DMS dataset is licensed separately (subscription info at https://tiny.cc/DMS), also via the authors, not UBS.
The homepage URL above is UBS's 2026 Yearbook landing page; UBS republishes a new landing page and a new summary PDF path each edition year, so the exact URL may need re-deriving in a future year.
